FAQs

What certifications do you have?

ISO9001 QMS, CE, RoHS, REACH, UN38.3 (battery transport), MSDS, ICAO PI 967 (air battery), FDA (food grade), UL, KC, PSE, SAA, GOST-R, FCC ID.

What is your MOQ?

Standard SKUs have an MOQ of 50-100pcs; custom mold MOQ is 300pcs. Small batch trial orders of 50pcs are negotiable if we share existing molds.

What to note for exporting to Russia?

GOST-R certification, Russian manual + labels, EAC mark (EAEU) required. Currently recommend re-export via Kazakhstan / Belarus, or use EAEU channels. We offer Russian localization.

What certifications are needed for EU exports?

CE (mandatory, multiple directives), REACH (chemicals), RoHS 2.0 (hazardous substances), PPE (personal protection), EN 60529 (IP), EN 62262 (IK), UN3373 (biological). One-stop CE service available.

How long do vaccine cold-chain cases maintain temperature?

2-8°C cold chain: 48-72h passive (PCM phase change). -20°C freezer: -25°C±2°C for 96h. -70°C dry ice: VIP vacuum insulation, -70°C±2°C for 72h. GPS temperature logger optional.
